recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E：肉芽腫中央為粉紅色顆粒狀壞死，周圍是細長核的類上皮組織球與同心圓纖維，左下緣可見多核巨細胞（Langhans type），外圍紅髓充血。
features: Central granular eosinophilic necrosis with scattered nuclear debris
Epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei arranged concentrically
Multinucleated giant cells at the granuloma periphery
Outer concentric fibrous rim; congested red pulp at corners
describe_en: Higher-power H&E section of spleen shows a granuloma with a central zone of granular eosinophilic necrosis containing sparse nuclear debris. The necrosis is surrounded by epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei in a concentric arrangement, with multinucleated giant cells at the periphery and an outer fibrous rim. Adjacent red pulp is congested. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation; infectious etiologies such as mycobacteria and fungi should be excluded with special stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas lack central necrosis and are composed of tight epithelioid clusters with giant cells.
Necrobiotic nodules show fibrinoid collagen necrosis in skin/soft tissue context and are negative for organisms, which requires stains to confirm.
Lymphoma-associated granulomas are non-necrotizing and accompanied by atypical lymphoid cells, which are absent here.
